name: api-command-infra
description: Pulumi AWS project for api-command (local backend, custom Go Lambda)

scripts.build:lambda: mkdir -p dist && (cd lambda && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/bootstrap .) && (cd dist && rm -f lambda.zip && zip -q lambda.zip bootstrap) && echo "built dist/lambda.zip"
scripts.build:layer: rm -f dist/catalog-layer.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -q dist/catalog-layer.zip catalog/products.json && echo "built dist/catalog-layer.zip"
scripts.build: npm run build:lambda && npm run build:layer
